Are you a female founder looking to expand your network?

Join us for an inspiring afternoon of connection, learning, and business growth alongside ambitious female founders from across London.

This free event features an exceptional panel of business leaders sharing real-world strategies for growth, resilience, community building, and brand visibility:

🔹 Tracey Butcher – Founder, Founder Mums Club
Sharing practical lessons on building a business and supportive founder community.
🔹 Soni Panda – Director, Soni Panda x LTD
Exploring Style, Strategy & Standing Out in Business.
🔹 Martha Keith – Founder & CEO, Martha Brook

Discussing how to market your brand effectively on a budget.

You'll also have the opportunity to connect with fellow entrepreneurs, exchange experiences, and build valuable relationships within London's thriving small business ecosystem.

📅 Monday 22 June 2026
⏰ 11:45am – 2:00pm
📍 London & Partners, 169 Union Street, London SE1 0LL

👉 Spaces are limited. Register today and join London's community of inspiring female founders - https://ow.ly/4hrj50Z8HHt
